scope: Sampled visual review: all10 designated stills extracted from the final96-second daytime tour plus six supplemental Shedd transition frames. This is not a frame-by-frame viewing of the full movie.

images.findings: Art Institute/Modern Wing and Chicago skyline establish the starting location.
Field Museum full north elevation and surrounding campus are recognizable in the connecting flight.
Stanley Field Hall, sauropod, elephants, columns and skylight read clearly from the side aisle.
A large structural pier temporarily occludes the rotunda habitats during the approach. Supplemental samples establish that the camera passes around it and reaches a clear dual-habitat view by32s.
Adler theater entrance frames the original projected sky; surrounding room is deliberately dark.
Original dome program fills the view; stars, aurora and constellation lines remain visible above seat silhouettes.
Soldier Field seating bowl, retained colonnades, field and museum/harbor context are visible.
Burnham Harbor piers, two detailed sailboats and water reflections are clear.
McCormick roofs, planted terraces, hotels and connecting campus volumes are recognizable.
McCormick skywalk and Lake Shore Drive corridor provide a coherent final campus view.

supplementalImages.findings: Clear Shedd west-approach exterior, classical portico and correctly scaled ticket pavilion.
Supported entrance ramp/corridor; rotunda pier visible ahead through the doorway.
Camera moving around the pier: both habitats are largely visible at its sides, with a narrow arch support still crossing the center.
Unobstructed centered view of both curved habitats, gold crowns and central passage.
Clear eastern gallery with representative side tanks and lake window beyond.
Clear Oceanarium overlook, reflective pool, curved glazing and Adler across the water.

findings: Scenery progresses from Art Institute/Field Museum through the museum interiors, Adler, Soldier Field, Burnham Harbor and McCormick Place.
Chapter captions and OpenStreetMap attribution are legible within the frame in every designated sample.
No image corruption, missing scene or persistent architectural blockage identified in the samples.

Shedd transition contains a visible pier occlusion around29–31s; it is resolved by the clear32s paired-habitat view and subsequent gallery/Oceanarium views. This was investigated and retained as a brief architectural passage, rather than silently waived.
limits: The sampled stills bound the Shedd transition to approximately29–32s; the precise onset/duration was not measured frame by frame.
Residual fine grain remains in shaded walls, aquarium glass and pool reflections at16samples per exported frame.
Still samples do not certify the absence of temporal shimmer or all obstructions at unsampled times; the separate full decode and motion reports cover different aspects.
Interior, exhibit, landscape and boat details remain authored architectural interpretations.
Dark theater seating is intentionally subordinate to the projected sky.
